stock.description: China Castson 81 Finance Co., Ltd. primarily deploys capital into a diverse portfolio of equity and debt instruments, encompassing both publicly listed and privately held securities. The firm exhibits a notable focus on emerging enterprises, with a strong emphasis on ventures within the burgeoning internet finance sector, as well as providing pre-initial public offering (IPO) funding. Established on September 14, 2001, the company maintains its principal office in Hong Kong.
